description: Defines an interface for DevOps configuration settings, including methods to determine security settings and retrieve passwords. Contains nested enumeration for default configuration values and paths.

classes.name: DevOpsConfig
classes.description: An interface providing methods for DevOps endpoint configuration, including security and password retrieval.

classes.name: DevOpsConfig.DevOpsConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, representing configuration keys and default values for DevOps settings.

methods.name: isSecureStatus
methods.description: Indicates whether DevOps status resources are secured with BasicAuth.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the BasicAuth password for all DevOps resources.

methods.name: getStatusPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the BasicAuth password for status-specific resources.
